cs.t: I'm currently using a Dobra:  https://www.amazon.co.uk/Dobra-Wallet-Light-durable-Tyvek/dp...  I have previously used a Dynomighty:  https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/product/B0093JFWGQ?ie=UTF8&th=1&...  They're both great. The Dobra has a slightly smaller footprint and individual pockets for cards. The Dynomighty has 2 main pockets for cash notes, but a single large card pocket on each side. The Dobra looks and feels a little bit more like a regular wallet. Even before then, I used to sport a cheap Tyvek wallet that I bought in Argentina with one of my favourite cartoon characters, Mafalda ( https://www.timetravelturtle.com/mafalda-statue-buenos-aires... ). It lasted about 10 years.
cs.th: ASK HN: What’s a small thing you’ve purchased which has made your life better?
